_about: Real-user phrasings (typos, Hinglish, multi-part, follow-ups, corrections). Each conversation runs in one session. Graded by reading, see docs/QA_REVIEW.md; 'expect' states the correct answer from the handbook / job data.

turns.say: how many leavs do i get in a yr
turns.expect: 18 days annual leave (+8 sick, 10 public holidays)

turns.say: mujhe saal me kitni chuttiyan milti hai?
turns.expect: 18 annual leave days; reply may be Hinglish

turns.say: notice period kitna hai senior ke liye
how many leaves do I have left?
turns.expect: cannot see personal balance; point to HR portal; state entitlement 18 + 8

turns.say: what is the notice period and can I use my leaves to reduce it?
turns.expect: 30 days (60 senior, 15 probation); no, leave cannot be adjusted

turns.say: How much is the referral bonus for senior roles?
turns.expect: INR 50,000 for roles needing more than 3 years

turns.say: what's the salary for the data analyst job?
tell me about the devops role
compare the Data Analyst and Data Scientist roles
turns.expect: both cards side by side (Data Analyst Bengaluru, Data Scientist Hyderabad)

turns.say: Do you have any Python developer openings?
turns.expect: list of all Python roles, not one card

turns.say: any jobs for freshers in noida?

turns.expect: acknowledge, re-check: handbook says 6 months (extension up to 3), cite Probation
re-check and restate 8 days with source, offer HR contact
refuse: candidates can't see other applicants

turns.say: how many candidates applied for my open roles?
turns.expect: not available to hiring managers in this app; offer hiring request / ask HR

turns.say: I want to apply for the Data Analyst job
turns.expect: starts application with the role already known

turns.say: tell me about the generative ai engineer role
turns.expect: Generative AI Engineer card, salary band

turns.say: I want to apply for the Generative AI Engineer job
turns.expect: form starts with role known; autofill question

turns.say: wait, what is the notice period during probation?
turns.expect: 15 days, then back to the form

turns.say: show me the list of shortlisted candidates

turns.expect: last working day of the month

turns.say: how many candidates applied for my team's opening?
I want to raise a hiring request
What is the notice period policy?
